40002321.author: पदार्थः
40002321.content: राजा king, सर्वशः in all ways, प्रगृहीतानि held out, तेषाम् their, अञ्जलिपद्मानि palms folded  like lotuses, प्रतिगृह्य having received, तेभ्यः for them, प्रियहितम् pleasing and beneficial, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40002321.author: Translation
40002321.content: The citizens held out their palms folded like lotuses in reverence and urged  king Dasaratha in all possible ways (to coronate Rama). He reciprocated their respect with words preasing and beneficial to them:

40002322.author: पदार्थः
40002322.content: मे my, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, प्रियम् beloved, पुत्रम् son, यौवराज्यस्थम् as prince regent, यत् इच्छथ  since you are desiring, अहो oh, परम प्रीत: अस्मि I am immensely pleased, मम my, प्रभावश्च  splendour, अतुलः incomparable.

40002322.author: Translation
40002322.content: I am immensely happy that you have added to my incomparable resilience with your  desire to see my beloved eldest son installed heirapparent.

40002323.author: पदार्थः
40002323.content: ﻿ राजा the king, इति thus, तान् them, प्रत्यर्च्य having honoured, तेषाम् their, उपशृण्वताम् एव when they were listening, वशिष्ठम् to Vasistha, वामदेवं च to Vamadeva, ब्राह्मणान् addressing other brahmins, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40002323.author: Translation
40002323.content: ﻿ Having honoured them (the invitees) in return for their response, king Dasaratha addressed Vasistha, Vamadeva and other brahmins.

40002324.author: पदार्थः
40002324.content: श्रीमान् auspicious, अयम् this, चैत्रमासः month of Chaitra, पुण्यः is sacred, पुष्पितकाननः with its groves in blossoms, रामस्य of Rama, यौवराज्याय for installation as heirapparent, सर्वम् एव everything, उपकल्प्यताम् be arranged, राज्ञः king's, वाक्ये words, उपरते were, महान् great, जनघोषः applause by the multitude, अभूत् arose.

40002324.author: Translation
40002324.content: This auspicious month of Chaitra is sacred with its blossoming groves. Let all the arrangements be made for the installation of Rama as heirapparent. On hearing this, all the members of the assembly applauded the king tumultously.

40002325.author: पदार्थः
40002325.content: तस्मिन् that, जनघोषे tumult, शनैः slowly, प्रशान्ते had calmed down, जनाधिपः lord of the people, राजा king (Dasaratha), मुनिशार्दूलम् tiger among ascetics, वशिष्ठम् to Vasistha, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40002325.author: Translation
40002325.content: With the tumult gradually calmed down, the lord of the people, the king (Dasaratha) spoke this to Vasistha, a tiger among ascetics:

40002326.author: पदार्थः
40002326.content: भगवन् O revered one, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेकाय for the installation, सपरिच्छदम् with necessaries, यत् which, कर्म performance , तत् (सर्वं) that, अद्य now, आज्ञापयितुम् to issue  order, अर्हसि should.

40002326.author: Translation
40002326.content: O revered one, you should issue appropriate orders to keep ready the necessary articles required for the performance of installation ceremony of Rama.

40002327.author: पदार्थः
40002327.content: द्विजसत्तम: the best of brahmins, वशिष्ठ: Vasistha, भूमिपालस्य king's, तत् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, राज्ञ: king's, अग्रत: in front of, स्थितान् standing, कृताञ्जलीन् with folded palms, युक्तान् counsellors, आदिदेश ordered.

40002327.author: Translation
40002327.content: Hearing the words of  the king, Vasistha, best of the brahmins thus ordered the counsellors who stood in front of the king with folded palms:

40002328.author: पदार्थः
40002328.content: ﻿ सुवर्णादीनि gold and other metals, रत्नानि gems, बलीन् offerings, सर्वौषधीः अपि herbs also, शुक्लमाल्यान् च garlands of white flowers, लाजान् च roasted corn, पृथक् separately, मधुसर्पिषी honey and clarified butter, अहतानि वासांसि च fresh clothes, रथम् chariot, सर्वायुधान्यपि weapons of every kind, चतुरङ्गबलं चैव army of four divisions also, शुभलक्षणम् possessing auspicious qualities, गजं च elephant, श्वेते white, चामरव्यजने fans made of Yak's hair, ध्वजम् a standard, पाण्डुरम् white, छत्रं च parasol, शातकुम्भानाम् golden, अग्निवर्चसाम् shining like fire, कुम्भानाम् of vessels, शतं च a hundred, हिरण्यशृङ्गम् goldplated horns, ऋषभम् a bull, समग्रम् complete, व्याघ्रचर्म च tiger skin, प्रातः early morning, महीपतेः king's, अग्न्यगारे in the place set aside for sacred fire, उपस्थापयत assemble.

40002328.author: Translation
40002328.content: ﻿ By tomorrow early morning arrange in the place set aside for sacred fire in the king's palace gold and other metals, gems, articles of worship, also herbs, garlands of white flowers, roasted corn, honey and clarified butter in separate containers, fresh clothes, chariot, weapons of every kind, army of four divisions, an elephant possessing auspicious marks, white fans made of Yak's hair, a standard, white parasol, a hundred golden vessels shining like fire, a bull with goldplated horns and a tiger skin.

40002329.author: पदार्थः
40002329.content: ﻿ सुवर्णादीनि gold and other metals, रत्नानि gems, बलीन् offerings, सर्वौषधीः अपि herbs also, शुक्लमाल्यान् च garlands of white flowers, लाजान् च roasted corn, पृथक् separately, मधुसर्पिषी honey and clarified butter, अहतानि वासांसि च fresh clothes, रथम् chariot, सर्वायुधान्यपि weapons of every kind, चतुरङ्गबलं चैव army of four divisions also, शुभलक्षणम् possessing auspicious qualities, गजं च elephant, श्वेते white, चामरव्यजने fans made of Yak's hair, ध्वजम् a standard, पाण्डुरम् white, छत्रं च parasol, शातकुम्भानाम् golden, अग्निवर्चसाम् shining like fire, कुम्भानाम् of vessels, शतं च a hundred, हिरण्यशृङ्गम् goldplated horns, ऋषभम् a bull, समग्रम् complete, व्याघ्रचर्म च tiger skin, प्रातः early morning, महीपतेः king's, अग्न्यगारे in the place set aside for sacred fire, उपस्थापयत assemble.

40002329.author: Translation
40002329.content: ﻿ By tomorrow early morning arrange in the place set aside for sacred fire in the king's palace gold and other metals, gems, articles of worship, also herbs, garlands of white flowers, roasted corn, honey and clarified butter in separate containers, fresh clothes, chariot, weapons of every kind, army of four divisions, an elephant possessing auspicious marks, white fans made of Yak's hair, a standard, white parasol, a hundred golden vessels shining like fire, a bull with goldplated horns and a tiger skin.

40002330.author: पदार्थः
40002330.content: ﻿ सुवर्णादीनि gold and other metals, रत्नानि gems, बलीन् offerings, सर्वौषधीः अपि herbs also, शुक्लमाल्यान् च garlands of white flowers, लाजान् च roasted corn, पृथक् separately, मधुसर्पिषी honey and clarified butter, अहतानि वासांसि च fresh clothes, रथम् chariot, सर्वायुधान्यपि weapons of every kind, चतुरङ्गबलं चैव army of four divisions also, शुभलक्षणम् possessing auspicious qualities, गजं च elephant, श्वेते white, चामरव्यजने fans made of Yak's hair, ध्वजम् a standard, पाण्डुरम् white, छत्रं च parasol, शातकुम्भानाम् golden, अग्निवर्चसाम् shining like fire, कुम्भानाम् of vessels, शतं च a hundred, हिरण्यशृङ्गम् goldplated horns, ऋषभम् a bull, समग्रम् complete, व्याघ्रचर्म च tiger skin, प्रातः early morning, महीपतेः king's, अग्न्यगारे in the place set aside for sacred fire, उपस्थापयत assemble.

40002330.author: Translation
40002330.content: ﻿ By tomorrow early morning arrange in the place set aside for sacred fire in the king's palace gold and other metals, gems, articles of worship, also herbs, garlands of white flowers, roasted corn, honey and clarified butter in separate containers, fresh clothes, chariot, weapons of every kind, army of four divisions, an elephant possessing auspicious marks, white fans made of Yak's hair, a standard, white parasol, a hundred golden vessels shining like fire, a bull with goldplated horns and a tiger skin.

40002331.author: पदार्थः
40002331.content: सुवर्णादीनि gold and other metals, रत्नानि gems, बलीन् offerings, सर्वौषधीः अपि herbs also, शुक्लमाल्यान् च garlands of white flowers, लाजान् च roasted corn, पृथक्  separately, मधुसर्पिषी honey and clarified butter, अहतानि वासांसि च fresh clothes, रथम् chariot, सर्वायुधान्यपि weapons of every kind, चतुरङ्गबलं चैव army of four divisions also, शुभलक्षणम् possessing auspicious qualities, गजं च elephant, श्वेते white, चामरव्यजने fans made of Yak's hair, ध्वजम् a standard, पाण्डुरम् white, छत्रं च parasol, शातकुम्भानाम् golden, अग्निवर्चसाम् shining like fire, कुम्भानाम् of vessels, शतं च a hundred, हिरण्यशृङ्गम् goldplated horns, ऋषभम् a bull, समग्रम् complete, व्याघ्रचर्म च tiger skin, प्रातः early morning, महीपतेः king's, अग्न्यगारे in the place set aside for sacred fire, उपस्थापयत  assemble.

40002331.author: Translation
40002331.content: By tomorrow early morning arrange in the place set aside for sacred fire in the king's palace gold and other metals, gems, articles of worship, also herbs, garlands of white flowers, roasted corn, honey and clarified butter in separate containers, fresh clothes, chariot, weapons of every kind, army of four divisions, an elephant possessing auspicious marks, white fans made of Yak's hair, a standard, white parasol, a hundred golden vessels shining like fire, a bull with goldplated horns and a tiger skin.

40002332.author: पदार्थः
40002332.content: अन्यत् any other, यत् च किञ्चित् even a little, एष्टव्यम् sought, तत् सर्वम् all that, उपकल्प्यताम् may be arranged, अन्तःपुरस्य for the inner apartment, सर्वस्य entire, नगरस्य च also of the city, द्वाराणि gates, चन्दनस्रग्भि: with sandalpaste and garlands, घ्राणहारिभिः sweetsmelling, धूपैः with burnt incense, अर्च्यन्ताम्  worship.

40002332.author: Translation
40002332.content: Even the smallest items required be arranged. Let the gates of the inner apartment and of the entire city be decorated with sandalpaste and garlands. Let fragrant incense be burnt for worship.

40002333.author: पदार्थः
40002333.content: अन्यत् any other, यत् च किञ्चित् even a little, एष्टव्यम् sought, तत् सर्वम् all that, उपकल्प्यताम् may be arranged, अन्तःपुरस्य for the inner apartment, सर्वस्य entire, नगरस्य च also of the city, द्वाराणि gates, चन्दनस्रग्भि: with sandalpaste and garlands, घ्राणहारिभिः sweetsmelling, धूपैः with burnt incense, अर्च्यन्ताम्  worship.

40002333.author: Translation
40002333.content: Even the smallest items required be arranged. Let the gates of the inner apartment and of the entire city be decorated with sandalpaste and garlands. Let fragrant incense be burnt for worship.

40002334.author: पदार्थः
40002334.content: यत् which, द्विजानाम् for brahmins, शतसाहस्रे hundred thousand, प्रकामम् to the heart's content, अलं भवेत् is sufficient, गुणवत् of good quality, दधिक्षीरोपसेचनम् cooked with milk and curd, प्रशस्तम् excellent, अन्नम् rice (be arranged).

40002334.author: Translation
40002334.content: Arrange fine rice cooked with milk and curd sufficient for a hundred thousand brahmins to eat to their heart's content.

40002335.author: पदार्थः
40002335.content: श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते early morning, द्विजमुख्यानाम् to the best of brahmins, सत्कृत्य having honoured them, प्रदीयताम् give, घृतम् clarified butter, दधि च curd also, लाजाः च roasted corn, पुष्कलाः in abundance, दक्षिणाश्चापि also gifts (be given).

40002335.author: Translation
40002335.content: At dawn tomorrow the best of brahmins be honoured with cooked rice clarified butter, curd, roasted corn and gifts in abundance.

40002336.author: पदार्थः
40002336.content: श्वः tomorrow, सूर्ये when the Sun, अभ्युदितमात्रे as soon as he rises, स्वस्तिवाचनम् swastivachana (a benedictory utterance), भविता should be made, ब्राह्मणाः च brahmins, निमन्त्र्यन्ताम् be invited, आसनानि च seats also, कल्प्यन्ताम् be arranged.

40002336.author: Translation
40002336.content: As soon as the Sun rises tomorrow, arrangements be made for Swastivachana (a benedictory utterance). Brahmins be invited and seats provided to them.

40002337.author: पदार्थः
40002337.content: पताकाः च banners, आबध्यन्ताम् be fastened, राजमार्गः च royal highway, सिंच्यतां च be sprinkled with water, सर्वे all, तालावचराः actors, स्वलङ्कृताः beautifully adorned, गणिकाः च courtesans, नृपवेश्मनः of the king's residence, द्वितीयाम् second, कक्ष्याम् the inner apartment, आसाद्य having reached, तिष्ठन्तु remain seated.

40002337.author: Translation
40002337.content: Banners be fastened and royal highways be sprinkled with water. All  actors and beautifully adorned courtesans should reach the second inner apartment of the king's residence and remain seated there.

40002338.author: पदार्थः
40002338.content: सान्नभक्षाः provided with food and other eatables, सदक्षिणाः together with gifts, माल्ययोग्याः  suitable persons to hold garlands, पृथक् पृथक् separately, देवायतनचैत्येषु in the temples and other places of worship, उपस्थापयितव्याः स्युः are to be stationed.

40002338.author: Translation
40002338.content: Persons to cater food and other eatables and to hold garlands and gifts be stationed at all temples and other places of worship.

40002339.author: पदार्थः
40002339.content: दीर्घासिबद्धाः men with long swords tied to their waists, सन्नद्धाः fully alert, मृष्टवाससः wearing new clothes, सर्वे all, योधाः च warriors also, महोदयम् highly glorious, महाराजाङ्गणम् courtyard of the king, प्रविशन्तु let them enter.

40002339.author: Translation
40002339.content: Let all the warriors in fresh clothes, armed with long swords and fully alert enter the courtyard of the glorious king.

40002340.author: पदार्थः
40002340.content: सुनिष्ठितौ highly selfdisciplined, तौ विप्रौ the two brahmins, तत्र there, एवम् क्रियाः functions to be performed, व्यादिश्य having ordered, पार्थिवाय to the king, निवेद्य च having informed, यत् whatever, शेषम् remained to be done, that one also, चक्रतुः च एव also performed.

40002340.author: Translation
40002340.content: The two highly selfdisciplined ascetics (Vasistha and Vamadeva), having ordered the tasks to be performed and whatever remained to be done reported to the king.

40002341.author: पदार्थः
40002341.content: प्रीतौ being satisfied, हर्षयुक्तौ with delight, द्विजर्षभौ the two illustrious brahmins, जगत्पतिम् lord of the earth, अभिगम्य having approached, यथोक्तवचनम् in accordance with the word of command, कृतमित्येव has been performed, अब्रूताम् spoke.

40002341.author: Translation
40002341.content: Satisfied with the arrangements, the two illustrious brahmins(Vasistha and Vamadeva) approached the lord of the earth (Dasaratha) with delight and said All things have been arranged in accordance with your word of command.

40002342.author: पदार्थः
40002342.content: ततः thereafter, द्युतिमान् effulgent, राजा king, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, कृतात्मा selfpossessed, रामः Rama, भवता by you, शीघ्रम् immediately, आनीयताम् be brought, इति thus, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40002342.author: Translation
40002342.content: Thereafter the glorious king said to Sumantra, Bring immediately the selfpossessed Rama.

40002343.author: पदार्थः
40002343.content: सः that, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, तथा इति so be it, प्रतिज्ञाय after acknowledging, राजशासनात् by the king's command, रथिनाम् among charioteers, वरम् excellent, रामम् Rama, रथेन on chariot, तत्र there, आनयाञ्चक्रे brought.

40002343.author: Translation
40002343.content: In response to the king's command Sumantra, the best of charioteers said, 'so be it'  and fetched Rama in a chariot.

40002344.author: पदार्थः
40002344.content: अथ afterwards, प्राच्योदीच्याः relating to eastern and northern countries, प्रतीच्याः च relating to west, दाक्षिणात्याः च relating to south, भूमिपाः kings, म्लेच्छाः च foreign (nonaryan), आर्याः च Aryan, वने in forest, अन्ये other, ये whosoever, शैलान्तवासिनः inhabiting the mountains, सर्वे all, तदा then, तत्र there, समासीनाः had seated, तम् दशरथं नृपम् that king Dasaratha, देवाः devatas, वासवमिव like Indra, उपासाञ्चक्रिरे paid homage.

40002344.author: Translation
40002344.content: After Sumantra had gone, the kings from eastern, northern, western, southern  nonAryan and Aryan countries, rulers from forests and mountains paid homage to king Dasaratha, as devatas do to Indra.

40002345.author: पदार्थः
40002345.content: अथ afterwards, प्राच्योदीच्याः relating to eastern and northern countries, प्रतीच्याः च relating to west, दाक्षिणात्याः च relating to south, भूमिपाः kings, म्लेच्छाः च foreign (nonaryan), आर्याः च Aryan, वने in forest, अन्ये other, ये whosoever, शैलान्तवासिनः inhabiting the mountains, सर्वे all, तदा then, तत्र there, समासीनाः had seated, तम् दशरथं नृपम् that king Dasaratha, देवाः devatas, वासवमिव like Indra, उपासाञ्चक्रिरे paid homage.

40002345.author: Translation
40002345.content: After Sumantra had gone, the kings from eastern, northern, western, southern  nonAryan and Aryan countries, rulers from forests and mountains paid homage to king Dasaratha, as devatas do to Indra.

40002346.author: पदार्थः
40002346.content: मरुताम् among maruts, वासवः like Indra, तेषाम् their, मध्ये in the midst, सः that, राजर्षिः sage among kings (Dasaratha), प्रासादस्थः sitting in the palace, रथगतम् sitting in the chariot, आयान्तम् approaching, आत्मजम् son, ददर्श beheld.

40002346.author: Translation
40002346.content: The rajarsi, (Dasaratha), seated among the kings like Indra amidst maruts, beheld his son Rama sitting in a chariot and approaching him.

40002347.author: पदार्थः
40002347.content: गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमम् appearing like the very image of the king of gandharvas, लोके in this world, विख्यातपौरुषम् renowned for his courage, दीर्घबाहुम् longarmed, महासत्त्वम् of immense strength, मत्तमातङ्गगामिनम् walks with the majestic gait of an intoxicated elephant, चन्द्रकान्ताननम् with countenance resembling the Moonstone, अतीव extremely, प्रियदर्शनम्  handsome to look at, रूपौदार्यगुणैः with his beauty and generosity, पुंसाम् of men, दृष्टिचित्तापहारिणम् captivating their eyes and mind, घर्माभितप्ताः scorched with heat, प्रजाः men, ह्लादयन्तम् gladdening, पर्जन्यम् इव like Parjanya(raingod), समायान्तम् approaching, रामम् Rama, पश्यमानः while gazing, नराधिपः king, न ततर्प was not satiated.

40002347.author: Translation
40002347.content: Rama appeared as the very image of king of the gandharvas known for his courage in this world. With his long arms, he was extremely handsome with a countenance of the colour of moonstone possessed of immense strength, he walked with the  gait of  an intoxicated elephant. He captivated the eyes and hearts of men with his beauty and generosity. He looked like Parjanya (raingod), gladdening men scorched by heat. Even after (intensely) gazing at Rama approaching, the king (Dasaratha) was not satiated.

40002348.author: पदार्थः
40002348.content: गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमम् appearing like the very image of the king of gandharvas, लोके in this world, विख्यातपौरुषम् renowned for his courage, दीर्घबाहुम् longarmed, महासत्त्वम् of immense strength, मत्तमातङ्गगामिनम् walks with the majestic gait of an intoxicated elephant, चन्द्रकान्ताननम् with countenance resembling the Moonstone, अतीव extremely, प्रियदर्शनम्  handsome to look at, रूपौदार्यगुणैः with his beauty and generosity, पुंसाम् of men, दृष्टिचित्तापहारिणम् captivating their eyes and mind, घर्माभितप्ताः scorched with heat, प्रजाः men, ह्लादयन्तम् gladdening, पर्जन्यम् इव like Parjanya(raingod), समायान्तम् approaching, रामम् Rama, पश्यमानः while gazing, नराधिपः king, न ततर्प was not satiated.

40002348.author: Translation
40002348.content: Rama appeared as the very image of king of the gandharvas known for his courage in this world. With his long arms, he was extremely handsome with a countenance of the colour of moonstone possessed of immense strength, he walked with the  gait of  an intoxicated elephant. He captivated the eyes and hearts of men with his beauty and generosity. He looked like Parjanya (raingod), gladdening men scorched by heat. Even after (intensely) gazing at Rama approaching, the king (Dasaratha) was not satiated.

40002349.author: पदार्थः
40002349.content: गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमम् appearing like the very image of the king of gandharvas, लोके in this world, विख्यातपौरुषम् renowned for his courage, दीर्घबाहुम् longarmed, महासत्त्वम् of immense strength, मत्तमातङ्गगामिनम् walks with the majestic gait of an intoxicated elephant, चन्द्रकान्ताननम् with countenance resembling the Moonstone, अतीव extremely, प्रियदर्शनम्  handsome to look at, रूपौदार्यगुणैः with his beauty and generosity, पुंसाम् of men, दृष्टिचित्तापहारिणम् captivating their eyes and mind, घर्माभितप्ताः scorched with heat, प्रजाः men, ह्लादयन्तम् gladdening, पर्जन्यम् इव like Parjanya(raingod), समायान्तम् approaching, रामम् Rama, पश्यमानः while gazing, नराधिपः king, न ततर्प was not satiated.

40002349.author: Translation
40002349.content: Rama appeared as the very image of king of the gandharvas known for his courage in this world. With his long arms, he was extremely handsome with a countenance of the colour of moonstone possessed of immense strength, he walked with the  gait of  an intoxicated elephant. He captivated the eyes and hearts of men with his beauty and generosity. He looked like Parjanya (raingod), gladdening men scorched by heat. Even after (intensely) gazing at Rama approaching, the king (Dasaratha) was not satiated.

40002350.author: पदार्थः
40002350.content: ﻿ सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, तम् राघवम् that Rama, स्यन्दनोत्तमात् from that splendid chariot, अवतार्य having assisted him to alight, पितुः to father's, समीपम् proximity, गच्छन्तम् proceeding, प्राञ्जलि: with folded palms, पृष्ठतः behind, अन्वगात् followed.

40002350.author: Translation
40002350.content: ﻿ Sumantra assisted Rama while alighting from that splendid chariot and followed him with folded palms as Rama was proceeding towards his father.

40002351.author: पदार्थः
40002351.content: ﻿ नरपुङ्गवः best among men, सः that, राघवः Rama, नृपम् the king, द्रष्टुम् to see, सूतेन सह accompanied by charioteer Sumantra, कैलासशृङ्गाभम् as lofty as the peak of Kailasa, तम् प्रासादम् that palace, आरुरोह ascended.

40002351.author: Translation
40002351.content: ﻿ Best among men, Rama accompanied by charioteer Sumantra ascended that palace that was lofty as the peak of Kailasa mountain in order to see the king.

40002352.author: पदार्थः
40002352.content: सः रामः that Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, अभिप्रेत्य having approached, पितुः father's, अन्तिके in proximity, प्रणतः bowing low, स्वम् his own, नाम name, श्रावयन् pronouncing, पितुः father's, चरणौ feet, ववन्दे touched with reverence.

40002352.author: Translation
40002352.content: Rama, approached his father with folded palms and bowed low near him, pronounced his (own) name and touched his father's feet with reverence.

40002353.author: पदार्थः
40002353.content: नृपः that king, पार्श्वे by his side, प्रणतम् bowed down with reverence, कृताञ्जलिपुटम् with folded hands, प्रियम् beloved, तम् आत्मजम् his son Rama, अञ्जलौ by holding the folded hands, गृह्य clasping, समाकृष्य drawing towards him, सस्वजे embraced.

40002353.author: Translation
40002353.content: Seeing his beloved son Rama who was standing by his side with folded hands in supplication, king Dasaratha, held his folded hands and drew him near and embraced him.

40002354.author: पदार्थः
40002354.content: राजा the king (Dasaratha), तस्मै रामाय for that Rama, अभ्युदितम् lofty, दिव्यम् excellent, मणिकाञ्चनभूषितम् decorated with gold and gems, रुचिरम् splendid, वरमासनम् best seat, दिदेश gave.

40002354.author: Translation
40002354.content: The king (Dasaratha) offered Rama a seat on the lofty, glorious throne splendidly  decorated with gold and gems.

40002355.author: पदार्थः
40002355.content: राघवः son of the Raghus (Rama), तत् आसनवरम् that lofty seat, प्राप्य having received, उदये in the morning, विमलः translucent, रविः sun, मेरुमिव like Meru (mountain), स्वया of his own, प्रभया with his rays, व्यदीपयत shone.

40002355.author: Translation
40002355.content: The lofty seat Rama occupied was illuminated by him resplenderce like mount Meru in the translucent rays of the morning Sun.

40002356.author: पदार्थः
40002356.content: ﻿ तत्र there, विभ्राजता while illumining, तेन by Rama, सा सभा that assembly, विमलग्रहनक्षत्रा with clear planets and stars, शारदी autumnal, द्यौः sky, इन्दुना इव like moon, अभिव्यरोचत dazzled.

40002356.author: Translation
40002356.content: ﻿ That assembly was illumined by (the presence of) Rama like the Moon dazzling the clear autumnal sky bespangled with sparkling planets and stars.

40002357.author: पदार्थः
40002357.content: तम् that, प्रियम् beloved, आत्मजम् son, पश्यमानः beholding, नृपतिः king, अलङ्कृतम् adorned, आदर्शतलसंस्थितम् image reflected in mirror, आत्मानमिव seeing himself, तुतोष experienced delight.

40002357.author: Translation
40002357.content: The king was delighted to see his beloved son as though he saw his own reflection adorning a mirror.

40002358.author: पदार्थः
40002358.content: पुत्रावताम् among those having sons, वरः best, सः राजा that king, तं पुत्रम् that son, सस्मितम् with a smile, आभाष्य having called, काश्यपः Kasyapa, देवेन्द्रमिव like Devendra, इदम् this, वचः words, उवाच spoke.

40002358.author: Translation
40002358.content: The best among fathers, he (Dasaratha) said these words to his son with a smile, like Kasyapa addressing Devendra.

40002359.author: पदार्थः
40002359.content: राम O Rama, ज्येष्ठायाम् the eldest, सदृश्याम् worthy woman, मे पत्न्याम् to my wife, उत्पन्नः born, सदृशः worthy, सुतः असि are a son, गुणश्रेष्ठः having excellent virtues, त्वम् you, मम to me, प्रियः आत्मजः beloved son.

40002359.author: Translation
40002359.content: A worthy son of my worthy eldest wife, O Rama, your great virtues have endeared you to me.

40002360.author: पदार्थः
40002360.content: यतः since, त्वया by you, इमाः these, प्रजाः people, स्वगुणैः with your virtues, अनुरञ्जिताः have been endeared, तस्मात्  therefore, त्वम् you, पुष्ययोगेन when Pushya star is in conjunction with the Moon, यौवराज्यम् office of heirapparent, अवाप्नुहि receive.

40002360.author: Translation
40002360.content: As you have endeared yourself to these subjects with your virtues, you shall assume the office of heirapparent when Pushya star is in conjunction with the Moon.

40002361.author: पदार्थः
40002361.content: त्वम् you, कामतः admittedly, प्रकृत्यैव by nature itself, विनीतः gentle one, गुणवान् असि are virtuous, पुत्र O son, गुणवत्यपि तु (in you) even though possessed of virtues, स्नेहात् out of affection, ते you, हितम् good,  वक्ष्यामि I shall speak.

40002361.author: Translation
40002361.content: Admittedly gentle by nature, you are gifted with virtues. O son, even though virtuous,   I shall offer you counsel for your good out of affection for you.

40002362.author: पदार्थः
40002362.content: भूयः still, विनयम् modesty, आस्थाय resorting to, नित्यम् always, जितेन्द्रिय: conquering the senses, भव become, कामक्रोधसमुत्थानि arising out of lust and anger, व्यसनानि च त्यजेथाः you should also abjure violations.

40002362.author: Translation
40002362.content: With humility, always keep your senses under control. Keep off all violations arising out of lust and anger.

40002363.author: पदार्थः
40002363.content: परोक्षया indirectly, वृत्त्या with behaviour, तथा also, प्रत्यक्षया with direct behaviour, वर्तमानः conducting, अमात्यप्रभृतीः ministers etc., सर्वाः all, प्रकृतीः people, अनुरञ्जय satisfy.

40002363.author: Translation
40002363.content: With your behaviour keep the ministers and the people satisfied by means direct or indirect.

40002364.author: पदार्थः
40002364.content: कोष्ठागारायुधागारैः with stocks of foodgrains and arsenals, बहून् many, सन्निचयान्  collections, कृत्वा having made, तुष्टानुरक्त: प्रकृति: keeping the subjects content and loyal, यः who, मेदिनीम् the earth, पालयति rules, तस्य his, मित्राणि friends, अमृतम् nectar, लब्ध्वा having obtained, अमराः इव like devatas, नन्दन्ति obtain pleasure, तस्मात् so, त्वमपि you also, आत्मानम् yourself, एवम् thus, समाचर conduct yourself.

40002364.author: Translation
40002364.content: You shall rule the earth by filling granaries of foodgrains and arsenals and keeping the subjects loyal and contented. The friends of such a person will memain pleased like devatas with nectar. Hence conduct yourself with your mind under control.

40002365.author: पदार्थः
40002365.content: कोष्ठागारायुधागारैः with stocks of foodgrains and arsenals, बहून् many, सन्निचयान्  collections, कृत्वा having made, तुष्टानुरक्त: प्रकृति: keeping the subjects content and loyal, यः who, मेदिनीम् the earth, पालयति rules, तस्य his, मित्राणि friends, अमृतम् nectar, लब्ध्वा having obtained, अमराः इव like devatas, नन्दन्ति obtain pleasure, तस्मात् so, त्वमपि you also, आत्मानम् yourself, एवम् thus, समाचर conduct yourself.

40002365.author: Translation
40002365.content: You shall rule the earth by filling granaries of foodgrains and arsenals and keeping the subjects loyal and contented. The friends of such a person will memain pleased like devatas with nectar. Hence conduct yourself with your mind under control.

40002366.author: पदार्थः
40002366.content: ﻿ तस्य रामस्य that Rama's, सुहृदः friends, तत् श्रुत्वा hearing that, त्वरिताः in great haste, प्रियकारिणः with the intention of causing pleasure, शीघ्रम् speedily, अभ्येत्य having approached, कौशल्यायै to Kausalya, न्यवेदयन् informed.

40002366.author: Translation
40002366.content: ﻿ Having heard this, Rama's friends quickly reported the matter to Kausalya so that she might be happy.

40002367.author: पदार्थः
40002367.content: ﻿ प्रमदोत्तमा the foremost of women, सा कौशल्या that Kausalya, हिरण्यं च gold, गाः चैव and also cows, विविधानि various kinds of, रत्नानि च gems as well, प्रियाख्येभ्यः (सह) messengers of these good tidings, व्यादिदेश ordered.

40002367.author: Translation
40002367.content: ﻿ The foremost of women, Kausalya ordered gifts of gold, cows and various kinds of gems to be given to the messengers who brought this good tiding.

40002368.author: पदार्थः
40002368.content: अथ thereafter, राघवः son of the Raghus (Rama), राजानम् king, अभिवाद्य having paid obeisance, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य ascending, जनौघैः by multitude of men, प्रतिपूजितः worshipped, द्युतिमत् splendid, स्वं वेश्म towards his abode, ययौ went.

40002368.author: Translation
40002368.content: Having paid his obeisance to the king, Rama ascended the chariot amidst the acclaim of multitudes of men and left for his splendid abode.

40002369.author: पदार्थः
40002369.content: ते पौराश्चापि those citizens also, तथा such, इष्टम् dear, लाभमिव beneficial, नृपतेः king's, तत् वचः that pronouncement, शृत्वा having heard, नरेन्द्रम् king Dasaratha, आमन्त्र्य having taken leave of, आशु immediately, गृहाणि to their homes, गत्वा having gone, अति प्रहृष्टाः full of joy, देवान् gods, समानर्चुः worshipped.

40002369.author: Translation
40002369.content: On hearing such pronouncement by the king, the citizens also felt they have got something beneficial for themselves. They took leave of the king (Dasaratha) and hastening home,  full of joy, began worshipping their gods. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे तृतीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the third sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
